summary: merge-grid-stats postinstall beacons to Burp Collaborator and writes marker files outside package directory
details: The package advertises itself as a 'merge-style grid games' utility, but its postinstall script performs two install-time actions unrelated to that stated purpose. First, it issues a DNS lookup for a subdomain under oastify.com (mgs-v11.owoemjgpf2c4qxqet92hexzvym4dsq6skvoa2cr.oastify.com), a Burp Suite Collaborator out-of-band listener under attacker control, confirming code execution on the installer's host and signaling reachability to that external DNS listener. Second, it writes NCODE_POC_MARKER.txt into the installer's current working directory and into two parent directories (../ and../../), producing unauthorized filesystem side effects outside the package's own install location. An in-code comment self-identifies the payload as an 'Authorized PoC' demonstrating install-time code execution and bounded DNS OOB, contradicting the package's declared purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
